messages:
Maya: noticing a recurring gap in the provisional ledger when prefetch is enabled on the sidecar. reproducer: start stream with prefetch=on, drop client mid-stream, check provisional vs confirmed credits.
Trevor: can you paste a trace? link?
Maya: https://internal/trace/abcd — key bits below:
```
[sidecar] sample_interval=50ms prefix_tokens=32 emit=partial
[router] route=us-west-1 -> handler A accepted chunk id=xyz fallback=false
[client] disconnected mid-stream (tcp rst)
```
Sushma: this sounds like the sampling granularity mismatch we chatted about, but here it's the sidecar emitting counts before router confirmation. provisional ledger gets the emit, but confirm never arrives so tokens look un-attributed.
Maya: exactly. sidecar emits `sample` early to keep metrics low-latency; router confirmation can come later or never if disconnect. result: provisional counts that never reconcile.
Trevor: Options: delay emission until confirm (adds latency), include session_id on the sample so we can match later, or mark emitted samples as `pending` so ledger treats them differently.
Sushma: adding session_id + pending flag seems lower risk. we can reconcile post-hoc for unmatched session_ids in a grace window.
Maya: proposal: 1) sidecar includes `session_id` and `sample_status` (pending|final) in sample payloads. 2) router emits confirm with same session_id when it sees the chunk accepted. 3) console shows a new metric "provisional-gap" per-route and alerts when >3%. 4) short-term mitigation: increase sample_interval for busy routes to reduce noise.
billing-bot: Created alert BILL-1234: provisional-gap > 3% in us-west for the last 15m.
Trevor: rough effort?
Maya: sidecar + router change ~2-3d, console metric + alert ~1d, reconcile job + tests ~1-2d, canary rollout planning 1d.
Sushma: also recommend a reconcile worker that consumes traces/logs for last 24h and best-effort matches session_id/prefix-hash to allocate provisional credits. prevents immediate customer impact while we roll the change.
Maya: i'll draft a PR with unit tests for sample emission and the session_id propagation. also add an e2e smoke test: stream with prefetch, drop mid-stream, assert provisional count appears then reconciles after confirm/reconcile run.
Trevor: console UX: add a column on per-route token table for `provisional` and a small explainer tooltip + link to runbook.
Sushma: canary plan: 5% traffic to new sidecar image, watch BILL-1234 and the `provisional-gap` metric; if drift <= 0.5% for 30m, expand to 20% then 100%. fallback via feature-flagged emission behavior.
Maya: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/sidecar/pull/724 (includes tests + session_id header).
deploybot: staging deploy started for redwood/sidecar@pr-724
Trevor: nice. once staging green, run reconcile job on a small window to sanity-check attribution.
Maya: will do. planning to pair with Sushma on reconcile job tomorrow morning.
Sushma: cool, i'll help with the worker and the dashboard widgets.
Maya: thanks everyone. pulling canary checklist into the PR description and adding rollback steps. :thumbsup:
Trevor: :rocket:
